Examples: * “I spend too much money on groceries” → Smart Grocery Planner * “My kids’ schedules are impossible to keep track of” → Family Routine Organizer * “I never know what to post on Instagram Stories” → 30 Days of Story Prompts * “I can’t stick to a budget” → Simple Budget Tracker * “I struggle to stay organized” → Weekly Productivity Planner Step 2: Use ChatGPT to Create the Content Paste this prompt: “Create a 5-chapter outline for a digital guide that helps [target audience] solve [specific problem]. Include the main points to cover in each chapter.” Within minutes, you’ll have a complete framework ready to customize. Step 3: Design It in Canva Choose a template, paste in your content, customize the colors and branding, then export your finished guide. Step 4: Upload It to Stan Store or Systeme.io Set up automatic delivery so customers receive the product instantly after purchase—no manual work required. Step 5: Promote It with Faceless Reels Create simple text-based videos, screen recordings, or tutorials. No need to show your face or record yourself talking. Step 6: Automate the Sales Process Set up an automated response so when someone comments on your post, they instantly receive the link. More engagement, more sales, less effort.
